Home.title: Focused speaking practice with human teachers and AI-assisted feedback

Onboarding.title: How will you use Takineo?

AdminDashboard.title: A focused workspace for trusted operations
AdminDashboard.description: Takineo administration keeps teacher review and operational controls behind a dedicated, server-protected access boundary.
AdminDashboard.reviewDescription: Open the protected queue to review pending submissions in oldest-first order. Each submission now has a read-only detail view; private video playback and review decisions remain intentionally unavailable.
AdminDashboard.reviewBoundary: Queue and detail data are read-only. Approval, rejection, playback, and moderation remain behind their existing server-authorized endpoints until their complete interfaces are introduced.
AdminDashboard.accessDescription: Administrative access is checked on the server independently from student or teacher product roles before this workspace renders.
AdminDashboard.accessNote: Interface visibility never grants administrative permission.

AdminReviewQueue.title: Pending teacher applications
AdminReviewQueue.description: Review the oldest pending submissions first. Open a submission for its read-only profile and review snapshot; playback and decisions remain intentionally unavailable.
AdminReviewQueue.emptyDescription: There are no pending teacher applications in this page of the queue.

AdminReviewDetail.title: Application — {name}
AdminReviewDetail.description: Inspect the current teacher profile fields alongside the submitted review snapshot metadata. This page is read-only; private playback and review decisions are introduced separately.
AdminReviewDetail.noVideo: No introduction video is attached to this application.
AdminReviewDetail.playbackDeferred: Signed administrative playback is intentionally not exposed in this milestone. It will be added with its short-lived authorization flow next.
AdminReviewDetail.actionsDeferred: Approval, rejection, and moderation controls are also still unavailable.
